title: Obscura Remova LTX23 Video-to-Video LoRA
summary: A specialized LoRA for video-to-video editing that reconstructs background scenes by removing foreground obstructions like plants, smoke, or haze. It utilizes deep feature hallucination to fill in missing visual data behind occluded objects.
research_notes: Recommended strength starts at 1.25; performance is significantly improved by interpolating input video to 50fps before processing.

evolution.summary: Evolved into a requested standard feature for integration into major video generation pipelines like Wan2GP. The model has transitioned from simple foreground removal to complex full-background reconstruction tasks.
